source: Public official 2026-04-09 legacy build. Independent implementation using behavior/constants; original code and art remain outside project.

references.unit_shell.gd: ability definitions / blink execution / no wraith footstep sound
references.selection_manager.gd: ability-ready subset, centroid 1.2 range acceptance, B targeting
references.battle_systems.gd: wraith-specific attack dispatch and scythe cleave
references.unit_roles.gd: wraith melee/undead traits, shock role, remaining attack fraction .4
references.unit_stats: wraith resource numerical record in official-unit-parameters.json

blink.selection: Only ready, alive, friendly casters participate. Mixed selections may use B on eligible subset; HUD button visible only if all selected living actors have blink.
blink.landing: Each origin aims toward the same target, independently limited to 200; no formation-preserving offset. Zero distance is allowed and spends cooldown.
blink.state: Clear current target and return to idle; existing velocity/attack timer remain. Local route and focus bookkeeping cleared. No instant walking distance is generated.
blink.terrain: Blink execution does not pathfind or check obstacle clearance. Ordinary movement after it still uses terrain and actual body radius.
blink.pause: Local UI prevents casting while paused; cooldown freezes with simulation. Same-condition original pause interaction has not been independently recorded.

cleave.selection: Primary hit occurs first and is excluded from splash; splash only opposing living actors relative to current facing; dead primary cancels the entire action.
cleave.damage: Every victim uses normal per-soldier frontal F protection and attacker identity/retaliation. Ordinary H does not reduce damage in Square.

art: Own Blender hood/robe/scythe, 64x64 eight-direction palette sprites; team stripes, pixel blink bursts and scythe arc. No original procedural mesh/shader/audio copied.
known_limits: Official legacy browser sandbox now confirms clamped blink travel, mixed-selection eligible subset and blocked/ready cooldown samples. Exact 8 simulation seconds, cleave metrics and latest Steam remain unverified by original runtime.
Exact spatial-hash radius boundary and candidate order are not independently measured; current local tests cover radius 50 and immediately inside/outside the angle.
General cooldown storage/RNG/physics ordering still differs from original packed Float32/native system; render-rate determinism alone is not equivalence proof.
Local corpse behavior and pixel sprite animation/trail differ from original wraith death burst/procedural renderer; audio uses local bank and capture is muted.
Ordinary post-blink behavior at an obstacle interior or outside map needs original-runtime comparison; local blink deliberately does not silently replace teleport with walking.
Full goblin/remaining undead/dragon, castle siege, navigation/death lifecycle, performance and end-to-end acceptance remain pending.
